sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000142-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Maple Grove Regional Hospital 142 on November 6, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Tdap share floor of 60%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: accepted by the Customer.
